task_specification.objective: Restore camera-safe Warden readability and seven truthful semantic animations with a materially different isolation/source-binding strategy, then make representative dense play and the natural title-to-result run release-qualifiable without regressing the accepted cemetery, combat causality, shell, lifecycle ownership, or provenance.

diagnosis.root_cause: The release candidate has three distinct convergence deficits. Its camera detects camera-to-Warden obstruction but applies a target-side overlay that does not guarantee a readable full silhouette behind the central mausoleum. Its explicit Warden animation profile intentionally contains seven empty mappings because the bound presentation source exposes no compatible semantic clips, so state telemetry changes without authored motion. Separately, candidate-side dense-profile and lifecycle instrumentation exists, but representative 1920x1080 final-wave stability and an uninterrupted ordinary seven-to-ten-minute victory/replay route remain unqualified.

stop_conditions: Do not edit, extract, reposition, duplicate, or replace authored children of the preserved cemetery package; camera repair must operate through camera/presentation integration around the intact environment.

Do not map semantically unrelated clips or synthesize whole-model spinning, bouncing, tinting, or translation as Warden animation. If neither the adopted source nor an intact, provenance-complete compatible presentation unit supplies seven truthful motions, leave the animation issue open and report the source incompatibility.

Do not use a prepared diagnostic victory, wave jump, artificial build, or performance setup as evidence that the ordinary complete-run route passes; diagnostic preparation and advancement must remain explicitly identified and release-guarded.
Do not optimize by weakening target legality, damage causality, enemy telegraphs, roster diversity, boss behavior, visual density, or reset isolation.

Stop implementation after the three selected gaps are candidate-ready and the preserved native project and host boot baselines pass; formal recapture, issue closure, and phase closure remain Tester/GameLoop Runtime responsibilities.

strategy.rationale: Two prior strategies failed to converge, so this iteration avoids further camera transform tuning and empty/fallback animation mapping. It repairs the camera at the visibility-composition boundary, restores or replaces the intact Warden presentation source only after inspecting its actual AnimationLibrary, and keeps dense-performance and complete-run qualification tied to representative gameplay and ordinary-route receipts rather than prepared outcomes.
